records.question: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.
records.gold_sql: WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS count_banned FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT T2.format, T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN MaxBanned MB ON MB.format = T2.format WHERE T2.status = 'Banned'
records.baseline_pred:
SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS banned_count
  FROM legalities
  WHERE status = 'Banned'
  GROUP BY format
), max_banned AS (
  SELECT MAX(banned_count) AS banned_count
  FROM banned_counts
)
SELECT bc.format, c.name
FROM banned_counts AS bc
JOIN max_banned AS mb
  ON bc.banned_count = mb.banned_count
JOIN legalities AS l
  ON l.format = bc.format AND l.status = 'Banned'
JOIN cards AS c
  ON c.uuid = l.uuid
ORDER BY bc.format, c.name
records.alt_pred: SELECT format, name FROM (SELECT l.format, c.name, COUNT(*) AS banned_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM legalities AS l INNER JOIN cards AS c ON l.uuid = c.uuid WHERE l.status = 'Banned' GROUP BY l.format, c.name) WHERE rnk = 1
